text: Medium close-up — warm, stable framing. Sarah reaches out to Mark, her hand gently touching his forearm. Mark's eyes widen with panic as he instinctively pulls his arm back.
Close-up of Mark looking at his phone screen with a sad expression. He types a message but deletes it. Sarah sits nearby, unaware.
Wide shot — physical barriers (table) dominate the frame. Mark is aggressively aligning plates on the table to avoid eye contact with Sarah.
Medium shot of Sarah touching Mark's shoulder from behind. Mark turns away toward the wall and pulls a blanket over himself.
Extreme wide shot — Sarah stands in the doorway looking back at Mark. Mark sits alone on the couch, looking at his hands.
Close up of Mark's empty hand extended into the air where Sarah used to be. The room is dark and cold.
